capabilities: export the vault as a JSON knowledge graph
encrypt the vault locally with a password before upload
upload the encrypted blob to a backend server
explore notes as a 3D graph on the Spectacles Lens
exclude folders or tags from syncs
disambiguation: Not a vault file sync tool for multiple devices; it uploads a one-way encrypted graph snapshot for viewing on Spectacles glasses.
extras: Sends data over the network: the vault is uploaded as a password-encrypted blob to a backend server (default URL configurable, self-hosting supported). A lost password cannot be recovered. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's graph view only exists inside the app, so there is no way to explore your note links as a 3D graph on AR hardware away from the desktop.

relations.evidence: sync it to a Spectacles AR Lens, where you can explore your notes as a 3D graph

requires.name: Spectacles AR glasses with the Lens

summary: Exports the vault as an encrypted JSON knowledge graph and syncs it to Spectacles AR glasses for exploration as a 3D graph.
